Maya: Hey team — quick heads up, starting a minute late. Mic in pod A is spiking noise, switching to backup soon. Can whoever's on deck update slides 3-5 to the latest roadmap note?
Ben: On it. I'm switching the pod mic to the spare now. If you hear feedback, tell me and I'll kill the channel.
Maya: Thanks. Also Q&A: leadership, want to hold live roadmap Q until slides are swapped? Don't want to riff without the visuals.
Priya: I'd prefer hold 2 mins. People ops will flag any urgent employee questions to leadership in chat.
Ben: Done — switching to 'Allhands Backup' scene in OBS now.
Ben: ```
/obs scene set "Allhands Backup"
# mic switch: amixer set Capture 0 cap
```
OpsBot: Recorder started: https://redwood.recordings/4312/slot1.mp4 :point_down:
Elena: I'm online. If there are product roadmap Qs live, I can grab ones tagged 'roadmap-live' and answer after slide 4. Keep them coming.
Carlos: Quick live Q — any change to Dedicated capacity rollout timeline for EU region? Last doc showed Q3.
Elena: Short answer: still Q3 but shifting to late-Q3 based on infra validation. We'll post a note in the roadmap thread after today's all-hands.
Carlos: Cool, please tag infra leads so SRE teams can prep.
Maya: Can someone add that to post-all-hands action items? Also ping infra on the recording.
Ben: Added to ops checklist. Action: @Carlos to follow up with @Liam (SRE) on validation windows.
Priya: Noted — I'll tack 'post allhands: roadmap timing note' to the calendar invite.
OpsBot: Recording link uploaded: https://redwood.recordings/4312/final.mp4 (processing complete)
Maya: Audio check — everyone ok on mute states? :speaker:
Ben: All good now. :thumbsup:
Elena: thanks all — I'll do the 3-slide roadmap recap once slides are live.
Maya: Great. Starting back in 30s. Keep Qs in thread and tag 'roadmap-live' for priority.
Priya: will do. :white_check_mark:
Carlos: Thanks — will follow up with infra after the meeting.
Maya: (thread ended) "
